modelTabRules.offeringLabelRule: Resolve Menu for an actual menu/food offering and Products for an actual retail offering. Merchant terminology cannot turn every order into a food menu.
Use Services for the actual appointment service, preserving onsite/remote distinctions.

Use Fleet for the actual configured vehicle/bike inventory in current routes. A non-vehicle asset presentation would require a separately supported actual offering route; it is not added by this matrix.
Use Services for actual transfer or greeting offerings; a greeter-only service is not a vehicle rental.
Use Services for the actual field-visit offering.
Resolve Services for a configured class/training service or Experiences for an actual activity/event presentation. Use the actual template and compatible merchant terminology.
modelTabRules.segmentRule: One Bookings peer tab. Only actually enabled and permitted model segments appear; each segment retains its own units, workflow, date basis and capacity definition.

modelTabRules.offeringLabelRule: Use Spaces for actual controlled tables or event-space offerings. This does not include an accommodation extension.
modelTabRules.segmentRule: One Bookings peer tab. Only actually enabled and permitted model segments appear; each segment retains its own units, workflow, date basis and capacity definition.

modelTabRules.offeringLabelRule: Use Experiences for actual tour/departure offerings. Supplier inclusions are not controlled accommodation inventory.
modelTabRules.segmentRule: One Bookings peer tab. Only actually enabled and permitted model segments appear; each segment retains its own units, workflow, date basis and capacity definition.

modelTabRules.offeringLabelRule: Resolve the actual enquiry/sourcing offering presentation: Services for coordination/enquiry, Products for a specifically configured product-sourcing presentation, or Experiences for a travel/experience request. The quote itself does not activate the requested downstream model.
Resolve Products for an actual made-to-order good or Services for an actual production/alteration service. Keep the accepted specification and due promise.
Use Services for the actual repair/assessment/job offering; a linked intake appointment remains distinct.
Use Services for an actual collection/processing/return offering; the linked legs do not create duplicate catalogue items.
Use Services for the actual freight offering; shipment, leg, weight and volume stay separate.
Use Services for a goods-storage service or Spaces for explicitly configured actual storage-unit inventory presentation. A unit is not automatically a hotel room.

Resolve the actual plan/access catalogue presentation. Product allocation rights, service plans and experience passes remain distinct. A pass is not an attended session or a recurring-order assumption.

admissionGates.meaning: Resolve the selected actual offering, location, configured model and allowed intake method through existing effective profile guards. Candidate models and category identity do not activate tabs.
The reporting owner rechecks merchant, location, report, field and drill-down permissions on every read, saved view and export. These are capability checks, not new role grants.

A metric needs its registered definition/version, real source owner/events, units, date basis and coverage. Missing evidence renders an unavailable/partial/no-history metric where the tab is applicable; it is not zero. No source gate silently enables an unrelated activity.

Resolve a compatible offering presentation from the actual registered template/kind and configured merchant terminology. The proposed presentation resolver is not a new runtime source or arbitrary executable rule.

Capacity needs actually controlled resource/typed-capacity accounting and availability evidence. Staff needs actual scoped provider/staff identities and permitted assignment, schedule or work-time source evidence, plus staff-dimension/report grants and applicable privacy rules. Model candidates, category identity and declared headcount alone enable neither peer.
Customers and repeat measures need permitted merchant-scoped identifiers and purpose/consent/suppression contracts. No raw private intake, clinical data or financial profiles enter reports.
Reviews use actual published feedback evidence and applicable suppression/read grants; requests for reviews are not published reviews.
Promotions requires actual campaign scope and permitted delivery evidence. Attributed outcomes separately require a defined model/window and complete observation.
Finance needs explicit financial-report grants and authoritative Finance-owned posting definitions. Payment, refund, settlement and payout permissions remain independent; currencies do not merge.

Reports is a peer destination for the authorized report catalogue even when some reports lack evidence. Saved views, detailed tables and exports reuse the same definitions, filters, evidence and access checks. Unsupported actions remain unavailable.

navigationRules: Overview, admitted business-specific tabs and Reports are peers in one Insights navigation model. Reports is not a tab inside a business-specific tab.

Reports is always a peer destination for an actor authorized to access the report catalogue, even when individual reports are unavailable. It contains the authorized catalogue, saved views, detailed tables and supported exports.
All peer destinations share one metric/definition registry, filter context, report query and authorization path. A second metric engine is not proposed.
Stable canonical keys and order are preserved. Compatible merchant terminology changes visible labels without changing underlying model, units or identity.
Resolve actual offering/model and exact effective guards first. Category presets only preview a presentation and never activate all candidate tabs.
A relevant admitted tab may show no-history, unavailable, partial or stale evidence states. Missing sources never become zero or proof of readiness.
Conditional Capacity and Staff peers require actual controlled resources, typed evidence and grants. They do not follow from category identity or declared headcount.
Saved links retain canonical tab key plus model segment, authorized location, date basis, period, unit and definition version. Removed access or capability is rechecked before rendering.

Pure mobility suppresses a duplicate Capacity peer when Fleet already reports the same asset utilization question. Capacity can display Departures or Sessions for actual dated resource scope; the canonical key remains capacity. A distinct mixed-resource hybrid Capacity report must be explicitly useful, evidenced and permitted.

hybridDedupRules.rule: Union admitted tab keys across selected enabled activities and render each canonical key once in stablePeerOrder.

Deduplicate sessions, spaces and tours into one Bookings peer. Show only admitted segments keyed SESSION_CAPACITY, SPACE_RESERVATION and TOUR. Retain per-segment units, workflow, date basis and metric definitions; do not create one combined booking conversion or capacity ratio.

Resolve one compatible presentation per actual catalogue offering. Menu and Products may both exist when actual distinct offering kinds justify them; they are alternatives for one offering, not duplicate views of that offering. Across models, one canonical offering tab groups model/type segments.

Within an offering tab deduplicate the same actual offering ID at its proper location/version scope. Multi-model routes remain available as labelled segments; accepted historical variants/specifications keep their own evidence identity.

One canonical Capacity peer and one Staff peer reuse actual resource identities. Capacity can display Departures for actual dated TOUR resources or Sessions for actual SESSION_CAPACITY occurrence resources. Pure mobility uses Fleet for rental asset utilization and suppresses a duplicate Capacity peer for the same assets/question; an explicit useful mixed-resource capacity report can appear for a hybrid. SPACE_RESERVATION uses Spaces/Capacity without hotel, room-night or lodging Occupancy assumptions. Staff requires actual scoped provider/staff evidence and grants. Shared pools are not counted once per offering or model; interval and unit definitions remain explicit.

Customers, Operations, Reviews, Promotions, Finance and Reports each appear once when admitted. Retain model-specific measures and independent privacy/finance grants instead of blending incompatible units or access.

presentationPresetPolicy: A reference-style restaurant, retail, wellness, rental or events preset can suggest labels and tab emphasis for review. Runtime admission, if later approved and implemented, resolves actual configured offerings and permissions; a preset cannot enable a capability or define business truth.

referenceOnlyExtensions.meaning: Accommodation layouts may inspire the reference treatment only. No lodging/room-night inventory, stay metric or accommodation model is added to the approved source scope. A separately reviewed capability and source contract would be required.

checks: 128 exact baseline IDs independently compared with effective profile source
Baseline candidate/default model suggestions and exact workflow options preserved
21 exact additional specialty/template/model tuples independently compared with source additions
15 actual model IDs mapped to 13 unique model-work peer keys
Overview first and Reports last in each deduplicated candidate list
28 unique stable peer keys; all requested model, offering and conditional shared groups accounted for
Every new mapping/rule/tab/gate row is PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW; no runtime enablement

offeringTemplateRefinement.meaning: Per-row candidates are narrowed by actual source template IDs; compatible merchant terminology chooses the visible presentation. These proposed hints do not approve new template fields, activate a model or introduce a runtime resolver.
offeringTemplateRefinement.menuAdditionalGate: Actual configured menu/serving presentation must exist. Food template identity alone does not make a packaged retail item a menu entry.
offeringTemplateRefinement.productionRule: Made-to-order goods use Products candidates; actual tailoring can use Products or Services according to the actual configured offering and terminology.
offeringTemplateRefinement.sessionPassRule: session_pass can use Services or Experiences; access rights remain distinct from an attended session.
offeringTemplateRefinement.otherSessionRule: Actual classes, training, coaching and workshops can use Services or Experiences according to their configured presentation.
offeringTemplateRefinement.unknownTemplateRule: A new template requires a compatible reviewed presentation mapping; do not infer a menu, fleet, space or other kind from category identity.

capacityPresentationRules.scopeResolution: Choose the display label from actual selected resource scope, not category identity or model candidacy. A hybrid resource scope keeps Capacity and explicit model/resource segments without blending units.

displayRules.when: The selected report scope is actual dated TOUR departure resources with permitted source evidence. This label does not activate departures or supplier inventory.
The selected report scope is actual SESSION_CAPACITY occurrence resources with permitted capacity evidence. This is a capacity presentation, distinct from the Bookings/Sessions work segment.
Actual controlled table/event-space resource capacity. Spaces remains the offering presentation. Neither label implies hotel inventory, room-nights or lodging Occupancy.

fleetAssetQuestionDedup.suppressDefaultCapacityPeerWhen: An admitted Fleet peer already covers the same actual rental assets, intervals, utilization definition and report question, and no distinct useful resource-capacity question remains.
fleetAssetQuestionDedup.allowCapacityPeerWhen: A merchant has an explicitly selected useful mixed-resource or other distinct capacity report with actual resource evidence and grants. A hybrid can then use Capacity with resource/model segments.
fleetAssetQuestionDedup.meaning: Pure mobility defaults to Fleet for its asset utilization question; it does not receive duplicate Fleet and Capacity peers for that same evidence.

requires: actual scoped provider/staff identities and appropriate source evidence

staffAdmission.forbiddenInference: A model candidate, category, declared team size or headcount answer alone never enables Staff.
